subject: Amaya - follow-up: security & data retention / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@amaya.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Amaya - follow-up: security & data retention / next steps

Hi Alice — great to meet you and Bob earlier today. Wanted to recap the follow-ups and clarify next steps on the security/compliance front so your security team can kick off the vendor review. Notes below: 

1) SOC 2 status: We are currently SOC 2 Type II in progress; we completed the readiness audit and expect Type II report availability by Q4 2026. I pasted a short SOC 2 summary below and attached a 1-page SOC 2 status doc for your team.

2) GDPR/HIPAA: Redwood supports GDPR controls and offers a HIPAA-ready deployment option (BAA available for dedicated/private deployments). We'll route more detailed legal/BAA questions to our legal team if you want to start that.

3) Data retention / deletion SLAs: Our standard hosted offering retains model request logs and compressed tokens for up to 90 days for debugging and quality monitoring. We offer configurable deletion SLAs for enterprise (Dedicated/Private) customers: typical deletion window options are 30/90/365 days; deletion requests are actioned within 72 hours once the customer provides the request and required authentication. Backups: encrypted backups (region-redundant) are retained for the same configured window and are also removed as part of the deletion workflow; we can provide a written description of the backup deletion flow.

4) Log retention: Access logs and audit logs are retained for 365 days by default for enterprise customers; shorter retention can be negotiated. Logs necessary for billing are retained as required for financial compliance.

Next steps we propose:
- I will attach the SOC 2 summary and a draft data-retention SLA doc for your security/legal review.
- If you want, Neha (cc'd) can run through the vendor security questionnaire with your security contact; she can fill the questionnaire and provide supporting artifacts.
- Please confirm which retention window (30/90/365) you prefer for the environment you'd expect to run on Redwood (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min session with Neha and Rishi to walk your security team through the controls and the deletion flow.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (1 page)
- data-retention-sla-v1.docx
From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@amaya.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bob Torres <bob.torres@amaya.ai>, security@amaya.ai
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Amaya - follow-up: security & data retention / next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick recap, very helpful. A few clarifying Qs from our security team so we can start internal triage: 

- SOC 2: Can you confirm whether the readiness audit identified any remediation items and if the Type II scope includes the inference runtime and key management? We will need a short statement for procurement.
- Deletion SLA: For hosted customers, if we select the 30-day deletion SLA as a purchase option, will that apply to backups in every region or only regional replicas in the primary region? We need regional deletion guarantees for our EU and NA data.
- Logs: Can you confirm whether debug logs include request/response payloads or only metadata (timestamps, request IDs, error traces)? Our privacy team is worried about PII surfacing in debug logs.

Also — we have a vendor security questionnaire (attached) that our security team uses for initial evaluation. Can Neha fill it out and return scanned artifacts? If you can provide a single point-of-contact for artifacts and the completed questionnaire, that would speed things up.

Appreciate it — we are aiming to have an initial vendor decision by mid-August.

Best,
Alice
Head of Security Programs
Amaya
alice.zhang@amaya.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@amaya.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Amaya - follow-up: security & data retention / next steps

Thanks Alice — good questions. Answers below and attaching the completed questionnaire + artifacts: vendor-security-questionnaire-filled.pdf.

- SOC 2 scope & findings: The Type II scope will include the inference runtime, deployment orchestration, and key management used in our hosted and dedicated offerings. The readiness audit flagged two low-priority items around automated rotation of a small subset of service credentials; those are tracked and expected to be remediated before the Type II cutoff. I attached redwood-soc2-summary.pdf which includes a short statement you can send to procurement: "Redwood Inference is progressing through SOC 2 Type II readiness; the Type II report will cover inference runtime and KMS integrations. There are no high-risk open findings; remaining remediation items are low priority and scheduled for completion prior to the Type II assessment."

- Deletion SLA & backups: The configurable deletion SLA you select will apply to primary region and to our controlled backups/replicas. For hosted customers with EU/NA data residency requirements we can pin the region for storage and ensure deletion flows act against replicas for that pinned region. For Dedicated/Private customers we support region-specific retention windows and can provide a written Data Deletion Flow document (attached as part of the SLA doc).

- Debug logs: Debug logs do not include customer prompt/response payloads by default; they capture request IDs, timestamps, model/route metadata, and anonymized error traces. We do have an opt-in debug capture setting that, if enabled by a customer for troubleshooting, can capture request payloads — that capture is configurable, auditable, and retained only for the troubleshooting window; it is not enabled by default. We can provide example log schemas if your team wants to review.

Attached: 
- vendor-security-questionnaire-filled.pdf (completed questionnaire; redacted where appropriate)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
- data-retention-sla-v1.docx (draft, shows 30/90/365 options and deletion timing)

Neha will take point on questionnaires and artifacts. Neha — can you confirm availability to hop on a 30-min call with Alice and Bob early next week to review the artifacts and walk through the deletion flow?

Thanks,
Marissa
